* [[September 11 attacks|9/11]]: Nearly two years after the September 11 attack on the World Trade Center, transcripts of [[World Trade Center (1973–2001)|World Trade Center]] emergency calls are released.  Voices of victims are identified on emergency calls and radio transmissions.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.usatoday.com/news/nation/2003-08-28-attacks-transcripts_x.htm |title=WTC transcripts include haunting pleas |work=USA Today |date=2003-08-28 |accessdate=2015-09-26}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://abcnews.go.com/sections/wnt/US/sept11_patranscripts030828.html |title=World News Tonight With David Muir |publisher=AbBC News |accessdate=2015-09-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040803105727/http://abcnews.go.com/sections/wnt/US/sept11_patranscripts030828.html |archive-date=2004-08-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://wireservice.wired.com/wired/story.asp?section=Breaking&storyId=776988 |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20051117131947/http://wireservice.wired.com/wired/story.asp?section=Breaking&storyId=776988 |archive-date=2005-11-17 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.news24.com/News24/World/News/0,,2-10-1462_1408592,00.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20081029021521/http://www.news24.com/News24/World/News/0,,2-10-1462_1408592,00.html |archive-date=2008-10-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://abclocal.go.com/wpvi/news/82803-911.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041012195505/http://abclocal.go.com/wpvi/news/82803-911.html |archive-date=2004-10-12 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* United Kingdom – ''[[2003 London blackout|London blackout]]'': A 34-minute [[power outage]] causes major disruptions in rail and Tube services in London and the South East when one of the National Grid circuits that feeds south London fails at about {{Nowrap|6.15 pm}}.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.sky.com/skynews/article/0,,30100-1101931,00.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040803201420/http://www.sky.com/skynews/article/0,,30100-1101931,00.html |archive-date=2004-08-03 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
* [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction|Nuclear program]]: [[North Korea]] announces that it is in possession of [[nuclear weapons]], has the means to deliver them, and will soon be carrying out a nuclear test to demonstrate this capability.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://www.cnn.com/2003/WORLD/asiapcf/east/08/28/nkorea.talks/ |title=No agreement at N Korea nuke talks - Aug. 29, 2003 |publisher=CNN.com |date=2003-08-29 |accessdate=2015-09-26}}</ref><ref>[http://www.canada.com/news/world/story.asp?id=9AED176F-099D-457A-91BB-E14CD4713A69 ]{{dead link|date=September 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=http://breakingnews.iol.ie/news/story.asp?j=78640634&amp;p=7864y34x |title=BreakingNews.ie &#124; Irish News &#124; Breaking News from Ireland |publisher=Breaking News |accessdate=2015-09-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041225074413/http://breakingnews.iol.ie/news/story.asp?j=78640634&p=7864y34x |archive-date=2004-12-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://abcnews.go.com/wire/World/ap20030828_983.html |title=Archived copy |access-date=2017-09-16 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20040618035252/http://abcnews.go.com/wire/World/ap20030828_983.html |archive-date=2004-06-18 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
